## Why This Is Asked
Tests understanding of circular shifts vs normal shifts and edge-case handling in a 32-bit width.

## Key Concepts
- Circular shifts vs arithmetic/logical shifts
- Width-aware masking and edge-cases
- Pure bitwise operations with no loops

## Code Example
```javascript
static inline uint32_t rotateRight32(uint32_t n, uint32_t k){
  k %= 32;
  return (n >> k) | (n << (32 - k));
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you adapt this for 64-bit inputs? 
- What changes if 0 < k < 64 is required?
